responsibility: Coordinates solving of `NormalizesTo` goals by distinguishing rigid from reducible aliases, dispatching normalization to the appropriate alias-specific handler or candidate assembly path, enforcing well-formedness checks required for rigid aliases, and providing shared helpers for constraining the goal’s expected term and translating impl/trait arguments during projection normalization.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is the specialization for `NormalizesTo` goals. Its code drives the rigid-vs-reducible alias split, dispatches to alias-kind-specific normalization (`inherent`, `opaque_types`, `weak_types`, `anon_const`), implements `assembly::GoalKind` for `NormalizesTo`, and handles projection-term instantiation, instead of providing general candidate assembly, generic evaluation context machinery, inspection exports, or the root solver module.
